title: The Information reports Google laid off trust and safety staff amid the Gemini backlash
summary: The layoffs came days after the controversy over Gemini's image generation, according to the Spanish Wikipedia account of the report.

title: AI Incident Database lists AI-generated images of Donald Trump with Black voters spread ahead of US primaries
summary: The images reportedly spread as disinformation before the US primary elections.

title: Anthropic releases the Claude 3 model family: Opus, Sonnet and Haiku
summary: Anthropic released three Claude 3 models in decreasing order of performance.

title: AI Incident Database lists Microsoft Copilot Designer generating inappropriate images
summary: The image tool reportedly generated inappropriate AI images.

title: Patronus AI finds GPT-4 reproduced copyrighted book text in 44 percent of test prompts, CNBC reports
summary: The test of 100 prompts found Mixtral, LLaMA-2 and Claude 2 produced copyrighted text in 22, 10 and 8 percent of responses.

title: AI Incident Database lists a Waymo robotaxi colliding with a bicyclist
summary: The self-driving vehicle reportedly collided with a bicyclist.

title: India approves the IndiaAI Mission with an allocation of INR 10,372 crore for 2024 to 2029
summary: The mission has seven pillars and an allocation of about USD 1.1 billion.

title: Bloomberg: Abu Dhabi said to target USD 100 billion in assets for an AI investment firm
summary: Bloomberg reported plans for an Abu Dhabi AI investment firm to target USD 100 billion in assets under management.

title: Singapore-based Silicon Box plans to invest EUR 3.2 billion in a chip plant in northern Italy, Reuters reports
summary: The company announced the investment for a new chip factory in northern Italy.

title: Cerebras unveils the CS-3 system with its third-generation WSE-3 wafer-scale chip
summary: Cerebras describes the WSE-3 as the fastest AI accelerator in the world; the claim is the company's own.

title: European Parliament adopts the AI Act by 523 votes to 46, with 49 abstentions
summary: MEPs approved the final text of the Artificial Intelligence Act.

title: Nvidia unveils the Blackwell B200 GPU and GB200 Superchip at GTC
summary: Nvidia says Blackwell cuts cost and energy use by up to 25 times versus H100 for some workloads; the figure is Nvidia's own claim.

title: Microsoft hires Inflection and DeepMind co-founder Mustafa Suleyman to lead a new consumer AI division
summary: Suleyman became CEO of Microsoft AI with Copilot as its flagship; Microsoft was also reported to pay Inflection USD 650 million.

title: French competition authority fines Google EUR 250 million over use of news publishers' content to train its AI
summary: The Spanish Wikipedia account says the fine relates to publishers' data used to train Gemini.

title: Intel set to receive almost USD 20 billion in US CHIPS Act incentives, Bloomberg reports
summary: The funding is for Intel's US chip plants.

title: AI Incident Database lists an alleged deepfake on Russian state TV blaming Ukraine for a Moscow attack
summary: The database describes an alleged deepfake disinformation broadcast on Russian state television.

title: Amazon completes its USD 4 billion investment in Anthropic with a further USD 2.75 billion
summary: Amazon invested the remaining USD 2.75 billion, bringing its planned total to USD 4 billion.

title: India's IT ministry issues an advisory requiring platforms to label AI output and seek permission before offering under-tested AI models
summary: The advisory asked intermediaries to label AI-generated content, inform users of unreliable outputs and obtain government permission for under-tested models, with startups later exempted.

title: China's Government Work Report, delivered by Premier Li Qiang, announces an "AI+" action to apply AI across industries
summary: The 2024 Government Work Report presented at the National People's Congress called for an "AI+" initiative to integrate AI into the economy.

title: Moonshot AI says its Kimi assistant now supports a lossless context of 2 million Chinese characters
summary: Beijing-based Moonshot AI announced that Kimi could process inputs of up to 2 million Chinese characters, opening internal testing of the long-context capability.

title: CNBC Arabia, citing The New York Times, reports Saudi Arabia plans a fund of about USD 40 billion to invest in AI
summary: The report said Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund was in talks with investors including Andreessen Horowitz about a roughly USD 40 billion AI investment vehicle.

title: Samsung Electronics says at its shareholders' meeting it will launch Mach-1, an AI inference accelerator, around the end of the year
summary: Samsung's semiconductor head presented Mach-1, an in-house AI inference chip designed to reduce memory bottlenecks, with mass production planned for late 2024.

title: UN General Assembly adopts by consensus its first resolution on safe, secure and trustworthy AI for sustainable development
summary: The non-binding resolution, co-sponsored by more than 120 member states, calls for AI systems that respect human rights and help close digital divides.

title: NTT begins commercial provision of its lightweight Japanese large language model tsuzumi
summary: NTT launched tsuzumi for enterprise customers, saying about 500 companies and organisations had expressed interest and targeting JPY 100 billion in sales by 2027.
